NIRAS Indevelop TIE LANES technical assistance

description.narrative: The Embassy of Sweden as a grant agent of Global Partnership for Education funds in Tanzania, plans to support the ministry of Education to build the capacity of its Institution Tanzania Institute of Education responsible for curriculum development and teaching and learning materials development. In this consultancy the Embassy decides to engage NIRAS Indevelop fulfil the following objectives: •Review the existing Curriculum Package and propose future improvements •Review the development of Textbooks and other supplementary materials •Build the capacity of books writers and develop Early grades reading materials.
